description: The NFIP Redacted Claims dataset on OpenFEMA gives details of National Flood Insurance Program claims transactions, derived from the NFIP system of record and redacted to protect policyholder information. The NFIP, created by the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 and run by FEMA since 1979, insures building structures and contents directly and through Write Your Own insurers; version 3 of the dataset held 2,725,989 records from 1970 onwards when read, last refreshed on 4 August 2026, and is updated about monthly with a lag. Version 2 (FIMA NFIP Redacted Claims) lists a deprecation date of 15 October 2026, and OpenFEMA also publishes redacted NFIP policies and multiple loss properties. Coverage: the United States and territories where NFIP operates. Access: API and full-file downloads through OpenFEMA. Licence: OpenFEMA terms with citation requirements; free. Caveats: data are not an official federal report, records are redacted to protect policyholders, and only insured losses appear. Simulation uses are observed flood losses for calibrating depth-damage functions and validating building flood loss models. Related records: FEMA Individuals and Households Program registrations and the First Street flood risk statistics.
